coverage.title: Defender TVM CVE exposure
requires: TVM inventory and published CVE detection
evaluation: Record actual CVE/device rows and collection scope.
If empty or unpublished, continue inventory, bundled-product and worker discovery; never pass as safe.

coverage.title: Defender for Cloud VM and running-container posture
requires: Applicable Defender plan, permissions and actual assessment coverage
evaluation: Inspect real assessment status, resource identity, affected package and advisory.
Review available Cloud Security Explorer and attack-path evidence without inventing relationships.

coverage.title: App Service and Function runtime discovery
requires: Approved Resource Graph scope; per-app configuration read if fields are missing
evaluation: Review all runtime strings and empty configuration, including slots and custom containers.
Verify the effective patch level separately; major.minor configuration never proves a patch.

coverage.title: Registry, running-image and zero-finding SBOM inventory
requires: Registry assessment coverage and separately authorized image/SBOM access
evaluation: Correlate actual findings by registry, repository and immutable digest.
Manually inventory deployed image digests and inspect SBOMs, including source-built PHP and zero-finding images.
Do not execute an untrusted image or suppress SBOM/pull failures.

coverage.title: MDE inventory, fixed-version and distinct-software review
requires: MDE software inventory and supported process telemetry for host discovery
evaluation: Compare runtime, not application, versions to the correct upstream branch.
Review vendor backports, prereleases, unparsed and unsupported branches manually.
Review distinct PHP names and all packages on observed web hosts for unlisted stacks.

coverage.title: Defender EASM external exposure
requires: Authorized EASM inventory export
evaluation: Review approved/live PHP frameworks, web servers, PHP-based components and IP banners.
Review distinct frameworks, components and server values beyond fixed keyword lists.
Preserve asset identity and export time; hidden PHP and internal assets remain gaps.

coverage.title: Code search and DevOps ownership mapping
requires: Explicit repository scope and authorized code-search/DevOps access
evaluation: Search PHP base images, package installs, Compose/Kubernetes and composer.json.
Review distinct repositories and map image digest to repository, pipeline and accountable owner.
Record search caps and inaccessible repositories; DevOps mapping is not free-text search.

coverage.title: Bundled PHP binaries and reviewed NCSC product leads
requires: TVM software evidence and reviewed local NCSC/vendor product rows
evaluation: Prepare nonempty local product input and preserve feed revision/date, source and advisory status.
Treat product-name matches and beta disk evidence as leads; confirm the actual serving runtime.
Inventory gaps, stale feed entries and an empty product template cannot pass as completed coverage.

coverage.title: Worker observations, mod_php proxy and unknown launchers
requires: MDE inventory, process starts and supported inbound network observations
evaluation: Prioritize Apache plus module-package observations without claiming the module is loaded.
Retain installed-but-quiet hosts and review unfamiliar PHP launchers/inbound processes.
Check long-lived workers outside retention; no recent start does not mean stopped or absent.

coverage.title: Optional authorized network fingerprint gap review
requires: Separate written scan scope, approved scanner/network reachability and SOC coordination
evaluation: Review separately collected approved fingerprints and distinct technologies/server banners.
Confirm leads with runtime/inventory evidence; absent PHP headers are not clearance.
No scanner, arbitrary target or exploit is run by this dojo.

coverage.title: Prioritize exposed high-risk worker candidates
requires: Row 09 classification and Row 06 approved/live exposure export
evaluation: Cross-match stable asset/owner identifiers, not hostname similarity alone.
Prioritize class 1/2 exposed candidates and retain unmatched/uncertain mappings for review.

coverage.title: Web worker children and legitimate baseline
requires: Supported MDE process telemetry and reviewed worker-name discovery
evaluation: Review shell, interpreter, downloader and discovery children with owner-approved baselines.
Validate shared worker-name coverage after discovery; in-worker execution remains a blind spot.

coverage.title: Syslog crashes, OOM and worker churn
requires: Linux AMA, Syslog DCR and actual application error routing
evaluation: Verify collection by host, facility and severity before interpreting results.
Review crash/memory/churn events and five-event 10-minute bins against health/load baselines.

coverage.title: App Service HTTP error, session and cookie leads
requires: AppServiceHTTPLogs in the intended workspace
evaluation: Review five 5xx POSTs plus request size over 100000 bytes per five-minute resource/host/client bin.
Review short POST/session/error clusters and request-cookie length over 1000.
Do not infer Content-Type, response cookies or an ordered exploit from these fields.

coverage.title: Application Gateway WAF and backend correlation
requires: Resource-specific AGWAccessLogs and AGWFirewallLogs, not Front Door logs
evaluation: Review POST/backend-error bursts and generic request-body/multipart rule leads.
Verify deployed ruleset mappings and correlate only nonempty transaction IDs within one gateway.
An unjoined firewall event does not establish backend success or failure.

coverage.title: PHP file writes and rapid deletion
requires: Supported MDE file telemetry
evaluation: Review worker/temp-path PHP-family writes and deletion within the inclusive following 10 minutes.
Check device, full path, hash and timestamps; CMS updates and path reuse are alternative explanations.

coverage.title: Worker and child-tool public network activity
requires: Supported MDE network telemetry
evaluation: Review direct workers on unusual public ports and child tools on any public port including 80/443.
Review excluded common-port direct traffic and private/unknown IP-type destinations separately.

coverage.title: AKS ContainerLogV2 worker errors
requires: Container Insights V2 and actual PHP/FPM stdout/stderr output
evaluation: Verify namespace, pod, container and resource coverage and worker-output configuration.
Review memory, timeout, signal/churn and session diagnostics as leads, not exploitation proof.

coverage.title: Custom web error and privacy-preserving access logs
requires: Custom WebErrorLog_CL/WebAccessLog_CL tables, AMA DCR and the documented access format
evaluation: Verify collection identity, nine-field parsing and explicit malformed-record counts.
Review multipart errors, chunked multipart and response-cookie size flags without collecting cookie values.
A '-' cookie flag is unobserved, not a negative result.

coverage.title: Patch, partial mitigations and closure evidence
requires: Verified PHP/vendor advisories, authorized change owner and effective web-SAPI configuration
evaluation: Verify the deployed vendor build or image digest contains the correct patch and restart all workers.
Review session upload-progress, PHP 8.5 backtraces, decoded-body limits and advisory mitigation trade-offs; do not blindly remove memory limits.
Never use RLIMIT_AS/RLIMIT_DATA as this mitigation; WAF markers and synthetic remediation do not close a real CVE.
